#Set Up
```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(here)

grn_dir  <- here("Data", "data_for_publication", "GRN_analysis")
out_dir  <- file.path(grn_dir, "subnetwork")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

consensus_filtered <- read_csv(
  file.path(grn_dir, "consensus_network", "consensus_network_deg_tf_top3pct_edges.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

module_genes_df <- read_csv(
  file.path(grn_dir, "selected_module_genes.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

tf_ortholog_file <- file.path(grn_dir, "AT_to_Mt5.0_TF_map.csv")
tf_base_file     <- file.path(grn_dir, "Mt_TF_annotation.csv")

tf_ortholog_map <- readr::read_csv(tf_ortholog_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
tf_base_map     <- readr::read_csv(tf_base_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

first_non_blank <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != "" & x != "NA"]
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_character_ else x[[1]]
}

tf_gene_names <- readr::read_tsv(
  here("MT_genome", "annotation", "MtrunA17r5.0-ANR-EGN-r1.9.gene_names.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    regulatoryGene = trimws(locus_tag),
    curated_name = dplyr::na_if(trimws(acronym), ""),
    curated_product = dplyr::na_if(trimws(geneProduct), "")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(regulatoryGene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    curated_name = first_non_blank(curated_name),
    curated_product = first_non_blank(curated_product),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

tf_genome_annotation <- readr::read_tsv(
  here("MT_genome", "annotation", "MtrunA17r5.0-ANR-EGN-r1.9.summary.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    regulatoryGene = trimws(LOCUS_TAG),
    genome_name = dplyr::na_if(trimws(GN), ""),
    genome_product = dplyr::na_if(trimws(PRODUCT), "")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(regulatoryGene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    genome_name = first_non_blank(genome_name),
    genome_product = first_non_blank(genome_product),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

tf_base_annotation <- tf_base_map %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    regulatoryGene = trimws(LOCUS_TAG),
    base_product = dplyr::na_if(trimws(as.character(PRODUCT)), "")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(regulatoryGene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    base_product = first_non_blank(base_product),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

tf_gene_annotation <- tf_gene_names %>%
  dplyr::full_join(tf_genome_annotation, by = "regulatoryGene") %>%
  dplyr::full_join(tf_base_annotation, by = "regulatoryGene") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    regulatoryGene,
    tf_acronym = dplyr::coalesce(curated_name, genome_name),
    tf_product = dplyr::coalesce(curated_product, genome_product, base_product)
  )

```

#Extracting subnetwork
```{r build-tf-ranking-function}
build_tf_ranking <- function(
  module_names,
  consensus_filtered,
  module_genes_df,
  out_dir,
  output_label = NULL,
  save_csv = TRUE
) {
  stopifnot(length(module_names) > 0)

  selected_module_map <- module_genes_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(module %in% module_names) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id, module) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  subnetwork_targets <- unique(selected_module_map$gene_id)

  consensus_subnetwork <- consensus_filtered %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(regulatoryGene),
      !is.na(targetGene),
      targetGene %in% subnetwork_targets
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(selected_module_map, by = c("targetGene" = "gene_id")) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tf_gene_annotation, by = "regulatoryGene")

  cat("Subnetwork edges:", nrow(consensus_subnetwork), "\n")
  cat("Subnetwork TFs:", dplyr::n_distinct(consensus_subnetwork$regulatoryGene), "\n")
  cat("Subnetwork targets:", dplyr::n_distinct(consensus_subnetwork$targetGene), "\n")

  tf_targets_top3 <- consensus_filtered %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(regulatoryGene), !is.na(targetGene)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(regulatoryGene) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_targets_top3 = dplyr::n_distinct(targetGene),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  tf_targets_sub <- consensus_subnetwork %>%
    dplyr::group_by(regulatoryGene) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_targets_subnetwork = dplyr::n_distinct(targetGene),
      median_geo_rank_subnetwork = median(GeoMeanRank, na.rm = TRUE),
      target_genes_subnetwork = paste(sort(unique(targetGene)), collapse = ";"),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  tf_module_breakdown <- consensus_subnetwork %>%
    dplyr::group_by(regulatoryGene, module) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_targets_in_module = dplyr::n_distinct(targetGene),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(regulatoryGene, module) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(regulatoryGene) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      module_target_counts = paste0(module, "(", n_targets_in_module, ")", collapse = "; "),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  all_top3_targets <- consensus_filtered %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(targetGene)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(targetGene) %>%
    unique()

  selected_targets_top3_n <- length(intersect(subnetwork_targets, all_top3_targets))
  total_targets_top3 <- length(all_top3_targets)

  if (total_targets_top3 == 0) {
    stop("No targets found in consensus_filtered.")
  }

  background_fraction <- selected_targets_top3_n / total_targets_top3

  cat("Total unique targets in full top3 network:", total_targets_top3, "\n")
  cat("Selected-module targets present in full top3 network:", selected_targets_top3_n, "\n")
  cat("Background fraction:", background_fraction, "\n")

  if (!is.finite(background_fraction) || background_fraction <= 0) {
    stop("background_fraction is invalid: ", background_fraction)
  }

  tf_rank <- tf_targets_sub %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tf_targets_top3, by = "regulatoryGene") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tf_module_breakdown, by = "regulatoryGene") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      subnetwork_fraction = n_targets_subnetwork / n_targets_top3,
      enrichment_ratio = subnetwork_fraction / background_fraction,
      enrichment_p_value = stats::phyper(
        q = n_targets_subnetwork - 1,
        m = selected_targets_top3_n,
        n = total_targets_top3 - selected_targets_top3_n,
        k = n_targets_top3,
        lower.tail = FALSE
      ),
      enrichment_p_adj = stats::p.adjust(enrichment_p_value, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      subnetwork_fraction = dplyr::if_else(n_targets_top3 > 0, subnetwork_fraction, NA_real_),
      enrichment_ratio = dplyr::if_else(n_targets_top3 > 0, enrichment_ratio, NA_real_),
      enrichment_p_value = dplyr::if_else(n_targets_top3 > 0, enrichment_p_value, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tf_gene_annotation, by = "regulatoryGene") %>%
    dplyr::select(
      regulatoryGene,
      tf_acronym,
      tf_product,
      module_target_counts,
      n_targets_subnetwork,
      n_targets_top3,
      subnetwork_fraction,
      enrichment_ratio,
      enrichment_p_adj,
      median_geo_rank_subnetwork,
      target_genes_subnetwork
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      enrichment_p_adj,
      dplyr::desc(enrichment_ratio),
      dplyr::desc(n_targets_subnetwork),
      median_geo_rank_subnetwork
    )

  file_label <- if (!is.null(output_label) && output_label != "") {
    output_label
  } else {
    paste(module_names, collapse = "_")
  }

  tf_rank_outfile <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("TF_ranked_subnetwork_", file_label, ".csv"))
  subnetwork_outfile <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("subnetwork_edges_", file_label, ".csv"))

  if (save_csv) {
    readr::write_csv(tf_rank, tf_rank_outfile, na = "NA")
    readr::write_csv(consensus_subnetwork, subnetwork_outfile, na = "NA")
    cat("Saved TF ranking:", tf_rank_outfile, "\n")
    cat("Saved subnetwork edges:", subnetwork_outfile, "\n")
  }

  invisible(list(
    tf_table = tf_rank,
    subnetwork = consensus_subnetwork,
    tf_table_file = tf_rank_outfile,
    subnetwork_file = subnetwork_outfile
  ))
}
```

#Rerank the subnetwork and Summarize top TFs across modules
```{r, load subnetworks}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tidyr)
})

subnetwork_dir <- file.path(grn_dir, "subnetwork")

module_order <- c("green", "magenta", "midnightblue", "skyblue", "white", "black",
  "red", "cyan", "turquoise", "lightcyan", "pink", "royalblue",
  "darkgreen", "lightyellow", "brown"
)

tf_files <- file.path(
  subnetwork_dir,
  paste0("TF_ranked_subnetwork_", module_order, ".csv")
)

missing_files <- tf_files[!file.exists(tf_files)]
if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop("Missing TF ranking files:\n", paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n"))
}

names(tf_files) <- module_order

```

```{r, ranking function}
rank_tf_table <- function(df, module_name) {
  required_cols <- c(
    "regulatoryGene",
    "n_targets_subnetwork",
    "n_targets_top3",
    "subnetwork_fraction",
    "enrichment_ratio",
    "enrichment_p_adj"
  )

  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required columns in module ", module_name, ": ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  df %>%
    mutate(
      n_targets_subnetwork = as.numeric(n_targets_subnetwork),
      n_targets_top3 = as.numeric(n_targets_top3),
      subnetwork_fraction = as.numeric(subnetwork_fraction),
      enrichment_ratio = as.numeric(enrichment_ratio),
      enrichment_p_adj = as.numeric(enrichment_p_adj),
      wgcna_module = module_name
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      enrichment_p_adj,
      desc(enrichment_ratio),
      desc(n_targets_subnetwork),
      regulatoryGene
    ) %>%
    mutate(rank_within_module = row_number()) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      rank_within_module,
      regulatoryGene,
      wgcna_module,
      module_target_counts,
      n_targets_subnetwork,
      n_targets_top3,
      subnetwork_fraction,
      enrichment_ratio,
      enrichment_p_adj,
      median_geo_rank_subnetwork,
      target_genes_subnetwork,
      everything()
    )
}

ranked_list <- imap(tf_files, function(fp, module_name) {
  message("Processing module: ", module_name)
  df <- read_csv(fp, show_col_types = FALSE)
  rank_tf_table(df, module_name)
})

combined_tf <- bind_rows(ranked_list)
```

```{r, ranking function by subnetwork outdegree}
rank_tf_table_by_subnetwork_outdegree <- function(df, module_name) {
  required_cols <- c(
    "regulatoryGene",
    "n_targets_subnetwork",
    "n_targets_top3",
    "subnetwork_fraction",
    "enrichment_ratio",
    "enrichment_p_adj"
  )

  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required columns in module ", module_name, ": ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  df %>%
    mutate(
      n_targets_subnetwork = as.numeric(n_targets_subnetwork),
      n_targets_top3 = as.numeric(n_targets_top3),
      subnetwork_fraction = as.numeric(subnetwork_fraction),
      enrichment_ratio = as.numeric(enrichment_ratio),
      enrichment_p_adj = as.numeric(enrichment_p_adj),
      wgcna_module = module_name,
      subnetwork_outdegree_rank = dplyr::min_rank(dplyr::desc(n_targets_subnetwork))
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      subnetwork_outdegree_rank,
      enrichment_p_adj,
      desc(enrichment_ratio),
      median_geo_rank_subnetwork,
      regulatoryGene
    ) %>%
    mutate(rank_within_module = row_number()) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      rank_within_module,
      subnetwork_outdegree_rank,
      regulatoryGene,
      wgcna_module,
      module_target_counts,
      n_targets_subnetwork,
      n_targets_top3,
      subnetwork_fraction,
      enrichment_ratio,
      enrichment_p_adj,
      median_geo_rank_subnetwork,
      target_genes_subnetwork,
      everything()
    )
}

ranked_list_outdegree <- imap(tf_files, function(fp, module_name) {
  message("Processing module by subnetwork outdegree: ", module_name)
  df <- read_csv(fp, show_col_types = FALSE)
  rank_tf_table_by_subnetwork_outdegree(df, module_name)
})

combined_tf_outdegree <- bind_rows(ranked_list_outdegree)

ranked_list <- ranked_list_outdegree
combined_tf <- combined_tf_outdegree
```

```{r, global summary and top TFs}
collapse_unique <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != "" & x != "NA"]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse = ";")
}

first_non_na_chr <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != "" & x != "NA"]
  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  x[[1]]
}

# gene_names.tsv is a short curated list; summary.tsv has full-genome PRODUCT/GN — merge so TFs not in gene_names still get tf_product
ann_gene_names <- readr::read_tsv(
  here::here("MT_genome", "annotation", "MtrunA17r5.0-ANR-EGN-r1.9.gene_names.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    regulatoryGene = trimws(locus_tag),
    acr_names = dplyr::na_if(trimws(acronym), ""),
    prod_names = dplyr::na_if(trimws(geneProduct), "")
  ) %>%
  group_by(regulatoryGene) %>%
  summarise(
    acr_names = first_non_na_chr(acr_names),
    prod_names = first_non_na_chr(prod_names),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ann_summary <- readr::read_tsv(
  here::here("MT_genome", "annotation", "MtrunA17r5.0-ANR-EGN-r1.9.summary.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    regulatoryGene = trimws(LOCUS_TAG),
    acr_sum = dplyr::na_if(trimws(GN), ""),
    prod_sum = dplyr::na_if(trimws(PRODUCT), "")
  ) %>%
  group_by(regulatoryGene) %>%
  summarise(
    acr_sum = first_non_na_chr(acr_sum),
    prod_sum = first_non_na_chr(prod_sum),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ann_tf_base <- tf_base_map %>%
  transmute(
    regulatoryGene = trimws(LOCUS_TAG),
    prod_base = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(PRODUCT) | trimws(as.character(PRODUCT)) %in% c("", "NA"),
      NA_character_,
      trimws(as.character(PRODUCT))
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(regulatoryGene) %>%
  summarise(prod_base = first_non_na_chr(prod_base), .groups = "drop")

mt_gene_names <- ann_gene_names %>%
  dplyr::full_join(ann_summary, by = "regulatoryGene") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ann_tf_base, by = "regulatoryGene") %>%
  mutate(
    tf_acronym = dplyr::coalesce(acr_names, acr_sum),
    tf_product = dplyr::coalesce(prod_names, prod_sum, prod_base)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(regulatoryGene, tf_acronym, tf_product)

at_alias_map <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("MT_genome", "At_gene_name_to_ID.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    At_ortholog = toupper(trimws(At_gene_ID)),
    AT_alias = dplyr::na_if(trimws(gene_symbol), "")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(At_ortholog), At_ortholog != "") %>%
  distinct()

at_annotation <- tf_ortholog_map %>%
  transmute(
    regulatoryGene = Mt5.0,
    At_ortholog = toupper(trimws(At_ortholog))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(regulatoryGene), regulatoryGene != "",
    !is.na(At_ortholog), At_ortholog != ""
  ) %>%
  left_join(at_alias_map, by = "At_ortholog") %>%
  group_by(regulatoryGene) %>%
  summarise(
    AT_ID = collapse_unique(At_ortholog),
    AT_alias = collapse_unique(AT_alias),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

tf_annotation <- combined_tf %>%
  distinct(regulatoryGene) %>%
  left_join(mt_gene_names, by = "regulatoryGene") %>%
  left_join(at_annotation, by = "regulatoryGene")

top10_each_module <- combined_tf %>%
  group_by(wgcna_module) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()

# Summary = union of top-10 TFs per module only; one row per TF; stats from top-10 rows only
tf_summary_across_modules <- top10_each_module %>%
  group_by(regulatoryGene) %>%
  summarise(
    modules_top10 = collapse_unique(wgcna_module),
    min_enrichment_p_adj = min(enrichment_p_adj, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_enrichment_ratio = max(enrichment_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    tf_annotation %>% dplyr::select(regulatoryGene, tf_acronym, tf_product, AT_ID, AT_alias),
    by = "regulatoryGene"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    min_enrichment_p_adj,
    desc(max_enrichment_ratio),
    regulatoryGene
  ) %>%
  mutate(global_rank = row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    global_rank,
    regulatoryGene,
    tf_acronym,
    tf_product,
    AT_ID,
    AT_alias,
    modules_top10,
    min_enrichment_p_adj,
    max_enrichment_ratio
  )

out_dir <- file.path(subnetwork_dir, "combined_tf_ranking_outdegree_first")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

iwalk(ranked_list, function(df, module_name) {
  write_csv(df, file.path(out_dir, paste0("TF_ranked_", module_name, "_reranked.csv")))
})

write_csv(combined_tf, file.path(out_dir, "TF_ranked_all_modules_combined.csv"))
write_csv(tf_summary_across_modules, file.path(out_dir, "TF_summary_across_all_modules.csv"))
write_csv(top10_each_module, file.path(out_dir, "TF_top10_each_module.csv"))

cat("Saved outputs to:\n", out_dir, "\n")
```

## Subnetwork size summary
```{r subnetwork-size-summary}
subnetwork_size_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(module_order, function(module_name) {
  edge_file <- file.path(
    subnetwork_dir,
    paste0("subnetwork_edges_", module_name, ".csv")
  )

  if (!file.exists(edge_file)) {
    stop("Missing subnetwork edge file: ", edge_file, call. = FALSE)
  }

  edges <- readr::read_csv(edge_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  required_columns <- c("regulatoryGene", "targetGene")
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(edges))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Missing required column(s) in ", edge_file, ": ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  dplyr::tibble(
    subnetwork = module_name,
    TFs = dplyr::n_distinct(edges$regulatoryGene, na.rm = TRUE),
    genes = dplyr::n_distinct(edges$targetGene, na.rm = TRUE),
    edges = nrow(edges)
  )
})

subnetwork_size_summary <- subnetwork_size_summary %>%
  dplyr::mutate(subnetwork = factor(subnetwork, levels = module_order)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(subnetwork) %>%

subnetwork_size_csv <- file.path(

)
```

# Load inputs for top-TF GO enrichment

This chunk reloads the saved top-10 ranking, the TF summary, and the top-3%
consensus network. Run it, then the GO chunks below, instead of the earlier
notebook sections.

```{r load-top-tf-go-inputs}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tibble)
  library(here)
  library(topGO)
  library(GO.db)
})

subnetwork_dir <- file.path(grn_dir, "subnetwork")
out_dir <- file.path(subnetwork_dir, "combined_tf_ranking_outdegree_first")

consensus_filtered <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(grn_dir, "consensus_network",
    "consensus_network_deg_tf_top3pct_edges.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

top10_each_module <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(out_dir, "TF_top10_each_module.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

tf_summary_across_modules <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(out_dir, "TF_summary_across_all_modules.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

cat(
  "Loaded top-TF GO inputs:\n",
  "  Top-10 TF rows: ", nrow(top10_each_module), "\n",
  "  Unique TFs: ", dplyr::n_distinct(tf_summary_across_modules$regulatoryGene), "\n",
  "  Consensus edges: ", nrow(consensus_filtered), "\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

# Generalized GO enrichment for top TFs

For every unique TF in the top-10-per-module union, Biological Process
enrichment is run separately for each module in which the TF ranks in the top
10 and once for all of the TF's targets in the consensus top-3% GRN. Module
targets are never pooled. All tests use the unique target genes in the
consensus top-3% GRN as the universe and topGO's `weight01` Fisher test.
Terms with Fisher p < 0.05 are retained. `weight01` already accounts for
the GO hierarchy, so no further p-value correction is applied.

```{r generalized-tf-target-go-enrichment}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(topGO)
  library(GO.db)
  library(purrr)
})

go_root_ids <- c("GO:0008150", "GO:0003674", "GO:0005575")
max_annotated <- 300L
min_query_genes <- 5L
top_terms_per_analysis <- 10L

all_genes <- consensus_filtered %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(targetGene), trimws(as.character(targetGene)) != "") %>%
  dplyr::pull(targetGene) %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()

if (length(all_genes) == 0L) {
  stop("No target genes found in the top-3% consensus GRN.")
}

go_file <- here::here("MT_genome", "annotation", "GO_gene_pairs_MtrunA17r5.tsv")
if (!file.exists(go_file)) {
  stop("GO annotation file not found: ", go_file)
}

go_pairs <- readr::read_tsv(
  go_file,
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene = trimws(LOCUS_TAG),
    go = trimws(GO)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", !is.na(go), go != "") %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, go)

GO2genes <- split(go_pairs$gene, go_pairs$go)
annotated_background_genes <- intersect(all_genes, unique(go_pairs$gene))

parse_target_genes <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(x), ";\\s*", perl = TRUE), use.names = FALSE))
  unique(x[!is.na(x) & x != "" & x != "NA"])
}

parse_topgo_p <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("^<\\s*", "", x)))
}

empty_go_terms <- function() {
  tibble::tibble(
    analysis_id = character(),
    regulatoryGene = character(),
    tf_acronym = character(),
    tf_product = character(),
    AT_ID = character(),
    AT_alias = character(),
    analysis_scope = character(),
    wgcna_module = character(),
    rank_within_module = integer(),
    query_gene_n = integer(),
    query_annotated_gene_n = integer(),
    background_gene_n = integer(),
    background_annotated_gene_n = integer(),
    GO.ID = character(),
    GO_term = character(),
    Annotated = integer(),
    Significant = integer(),
    Expected = double(),
    fold_enrichment = double(),
    Fisher_p_value = double()
  )
}

make_analysis_row <- function(
  regulatory_gene,
  tf_acronym,
  tf_product,
  at_id,
  at_alias,
  analysis_scope,
  wgcna_module,
  rank_within_module,
  query_genes
) {
  module_key <- if (is.na(wgcna_module)) "all_GRN_targets" else wgcna_module
  tibble::tibble(
    analysis_id = paste(regulatory_gene, analysis_scope, module_key, sep = "__"),
    regulatoryGene = regulatory_gene,
    tf_acronym = tf_acronym,
    tf_product = tf_product,
    AT_ID = at_id,
    AT_alias = at_alias,
    analysis_scope = analysis_scope,
    wgcna_module = wgcna_module,
    rank_within_module = as.integer(rank_within_module),
    query_genes = list(sort(unique(query_genes)))
  )
}

module_analyses <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(top10_each_module)),
  function(i) {
    row <- top10_each_module[i, , drop = FALSE]
    annotation <- tf_summary_across_modules %>%
      dplyr::filter(regulatoryGene == row$regulatoryGene[[1]]) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)

    make_analysis_row(
      regulatory_gene = row$regulatoryGene[[1]],
      tf_acronym = row$tf_acronym[[1]],
      tf_product = row$tf_product[[1]],
      at_id = annotation$AT_ID[[1]],
      at_alias = annotation$AT_alias[[1]],
      analysis_scope = "module",
      wgcna_module = as.character(row$wgcna_module[[1]]),
      rank_within_module = row$rank_within_module[[1]],
      query_genes = parse_target_genes(row$target_genes_subnetwork[[1]])
    )
  }
)

selected_tf_annotation <- tf_summary_across_modules %>%
  dplyr::select(
    regulatoryGene, tf_acronym, tf_product, AT_ID, AT_alias
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(regulatoryGene, .keep_all = TRUE)

global_analyses <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(selected_tf_annotation)),
  function(i) {
    row <- selected_tf_annotation[i, , drop = FALSE]
    tf_targets <- consensus_filtered %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        regulatoryGene == row$regulatoryGene[[1]],
        !is.na(targetGene),
        trimws(as.character(targetGene)) != ""
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(targetGene)

    make_analysis_row(
      regulatory_gene = row$regulatoryGene[[1]],
      tf_acronym = row$tf_acronym[[1]],
      tf_product = row$tf_product[[1]],
      at_id = row$AT_ID[[1]],
      at_alias = row$AT_alias[[1]],
      analysis_scope = "all_GRN_targets",
      wgcna_module = NA_character_,
      rank_within_module = NA_integer_,
      query_genes = tf_targets
    )
  }
)

go_analyses <- dplyr::bind_rows(module_analyses, global_analyses) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    query_genes = purrr::map(query_genes, ~ intersect(unique(.x), all_genes))
  )

if (anyDuplicated(go_analyses$analysis_id)) {
  stop("GO analysis IDs are not unique.")
}

run_go_analysis <- function(analysis_row) {
  query_genes <- analysis_row$query_genes[[1]]
  query_annotated_genes <- intersect(query_genes, annotated_background_genes)
  query_gene_n <- length(query_genes)
  query_annotated_gene_n <- length(query_annotated_genes)

  summary_base <- analysis_row %>%
    dplyr::select(-query_genes) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      query_gene_n = query_gene_n,
      query_annotated_gene_n = query_annotated_gene_n,
      background_gene_n = length(all_genes),
      background_annotated_gene_n = length(annotated_background_genes)
    )

  if (query_gene_n < min_query_genes) {
    return(list(
      terms = empty_go_terms(),
      summary = summary_base %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          status = "skipped",
          status_reason = paste0("fewer than ", min_query_genes, " query genes"),
          tested_term_n = 0L
        )
    ))
  }

  if (query_annotated_gene_n < min_query_genes) {
    return(list(
      terms = empty_go_terms(),
      summary = summary_base %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          status = "skipped",
          status_reason = paste0("fewer than ", min_query_genes, " GO-annotated query genes"),
          tested_term_n = 0L
        )
    ))
  }

  gene_list <- stats::setNames(as.integer(all_genes %in% query_genes), all_genes)
  GOdata <- methods::new(
    "topGOdata",
    ontology = "BP",
    allGenes = gene_list,
    geneSel = function(x) x == 1,
    annot = annFUN.GO2genes,
    GO2genes = GO2genes,
    nodeSize = 5
  )
  fisher_result <- runTest(GOdata, algorithm = "weight01", statistic = "fisher")
  tested_term_n <- length(score(fisher_result))

  if (tested_term_n == 0L) {
    return(list(
      terms = empty_go_terms(),
      summary = summary_base %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          status = "completed_no_terms",
          status_reason = "topGO returned no tested BP terms",
          tested_term_n = 0L
        )
    ))
  }

  topgo_table <- GenTable(
    GOdata,
    Fisher = fisher_result,
    orderBy = "Fisher",
    ranksOf = "Fisher",
    topNodes = tested_term_n,
    numChar = 1000
  )

  go_info <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    GO.db,
    keys = unique(topgo_table$GO.ID),
    keytype = "GOID",
    columns = c("TERM", "ONTOLOGY")
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(ONTOLOGY == "BP") %>%
    dplyr::distinct(GOID, .keep_all = TRUE)

  terms <- topgo_table %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      go_info %>% dplyr::rename(GO.ID = GOID),
      by = "GO.ID"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      GO_term = dplyr::coalesce(TERM, Term),
      Annotated = suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(Annotated))),
      Significant = suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(Significant))),
      Expected = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(Expected))),
      Fisher_p_value = parse_topgo_p(Fisher),
      fold_enrichment = dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(Expected) & Expected > 0 & !is.na(Significant),
        Significant / Expected,
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      analysis_id = analysis_row$analysis_id[[1]],
      regulatoryGene = analysis_row$regulatoryGene[[1]],
      tf_acronym = analysis_row$tf_acronym[[1]],
      tf_product = analysis_row$tf_product[[1]],
      AT_ID = analysis_row$AT_ID[[1]],
      AT_alias = analysis_row$AT_alias[[1]],
      analysis_scope = analysis_row$analysis_scope[[1]],
      wgcna_module = analysis_row$wgcna_module[[1]],
      rank_within_module = analysis_row$rank_within_module[[1]],
      query_gene_n,
      query_annotated_gene_n,
      background_gene_n = length(all_genes),
      background_annotated_gene_n = length(annotated_background_genes),
      GO.ID,
      GO_term,
      Annotated,
      Significant,
      Expected,
      fold_enrichment,
      Fisher_p_value
    )

  list(
    terms = terms,
    summary = summary_base %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        status = "completed",
        status_reason = NA_character_,
        tested_term_n = nrow(terms)
      )
  )
}

go_results <- purrr::map(
  split(go_analyses, seq_len(nrow(go_analyses))),
  run_go_analysis
)

tf_go_all_terms <- purrr::map_dfr(go_results, "terms") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    passes_display_filter = (
      !GO.ID %in% go_root_ids &
        !is.na(Annotated) &
        Annotated <= max_annotated
    ),
    significant_within_analysis = (
      passes_display_filter &
        !is.na(Fisher_p_value) &
        Fisher_p_value < 0.05
    )
  )

tf_go_significant <- tf_go_all_terms %>%
  dplyr::filter(significant_within_analysis) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    regulatoryGene, analysis_scope, wgcna_module,
    Fisher_p_value, GO.ID
  )

tf_go_top_terms <- tf_go_significant %>%
  dplyr::group_by(analysis_id) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Fisher_p_value,
    dplyr::desc(fold_enrichment),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = top_terms_per_analysis) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(term_rank = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(term_rank, dplyr::everything())

significance_counts <- tf_go_all_terms %>%
  dplyr::group_by(analysis_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    significant_term_n = sum(significant_within_analysis, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

tf_go_query_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(go_results, "summary") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(significance_counts, by = "analysis_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significant_term_n = dplyr::coalesce(significant_term_n, 0L),
    status = dplyr::if_else(
      status == "completed" & significant_term_n == 0L,
      "completed_no_significant_terms",
      status
    ),
    status_reason = dplyr::if_else(
      status == "completed_no_significant_terms" & is.na(status_reason),
      "no BP terms passed weight01 Fisher p < 0.05 and display filters",
      status_reason
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(regulatoryGene, analysis_scope, wgcna_module)

output_files <- c(
  query_summary = file.path(out_dir, "TF_GO_BP_query_summary.csv"),
  all_terms = file.path(out_dir, "TF_GO_BP_all_terms.csv"),
  significant = file.path(out_dir, "TF_GO_BP_significant.csv"),
  top_terms = file.path(out_dir, "TF_GO_BP_top_terms.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(tf_go_query_summary, output_files[["query_summary"]], na = "NA")
readr::write_csv(tf_go_all_terms, output_files[["all_terms"]], na = "NA")
readr::write_csv(tf_go_significant, output_files[["significant"]], na = "NA")
readr::write_csv(tf_go_top_terms, output_files[["top_terms"]], na = "NA")

cat(
  "Generalized TF target GO (BP):\n",
  "  Selected TFs: ", dplyr::n_distinct(go_analyses$regulatoryGene), "\n",
  "  Module analyses: ", sum(go_analyses$analysis_scope == "module"), "\n",
  "  All-GRN-target analyses: ",
  sum(go_analyses$analysis_scope == "all_GRN_targets"), "\n",
  "  Tested term rows: ", nrow(tf_go_all_terms), "\n",
  "  Significant term rows: ", nrow(tf_go_significant), "\n",
  "  Outputs: ", paste(output_files, collapse = "\n           "), "\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

# Gene-level long table for significant TF GO terms

This chunk does not rerun enrichment. It reads `TF_GO_BP_significant.csv` and
expands each saved term to the query genes annotated to that term or to one
of its Biological Process descendants.

```{r significant-tf-go-gene-long}
significant_go_csv <- file.path(out_dir, "TF_GO_BP_significant.csv")
if (!file.exists(significant_go_csv)) {
  stop("Significant GO output not found: ", significant_go_csv)
}

tf_go_significant_saved <- readr::read_csv(
  significant_go_csv,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

parse_target_genes <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(x), ";\\s*", perl = TRUE), use.names = FALSE))
  unique(x[!is.na(x) & x != "" & x != "NA"])
}

background_genes <- consensus_filtered %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(targetGene), trimws(as.character(targetGene)) != "") %>%
  dplyr::pull(targetGene) %>%
  unique()

module_query_genes <- top10_each_module %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    analysis_id = paste(regulatoryGene, "module", wgcna_module, sep = "__"),
    targetGene = purrr::map(
      target_genes_subnetwork,
      ~ intersect(parse_target_genes(.x), background_genes)
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(targetGene)

global_query_genes <- consensus_filtered %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(targetGene), trimws(as.character(targetGene)) != "") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    analysis_id = paste(regulatoryGene, "all_GRN_targets", "all_GRN_targets", sep = "__"),
    targetGene = trimws(as.character(targetGene))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(targetGene != "", targetGene %in% background_genes) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

query_genes_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(module_query_genes, global_query_genes) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

go_pairs <- readr::read_tsv(
  here::here("MT_genome", "annotation", "GO_gene_pairs_MtrunA17r5.tsv"),
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(gene = trimws(LOCUS_TAG), go = trimws(GO)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", !is.na(go), go != "") %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

significant_go_ids <- unique(tf_go_significant_saved$GO.ID)
offspring <- AnnotationDbi::as.list(GO.db::GOBPOFFSPRING[significant_go_ids])
term_members <- purrr::imap_dfr(offspring, function(children, term_id) {
  children <- children[!is.na(children)]
  tibble::tibble(
    GO.ID = term_id,
    go = unique(c(term_id, children))
  )
})

genes_in_significant_terms <- term_members %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(go_pairs, by = "go") %>%
  dplyr::distinct(GO.ID, targetGene = gene)

tf_go_significant_gene_long <- tf_go_significant_saved %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(query_genes_long, by = "analysis_id", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(genes_in_significant_terms, by = c("GO.ID", "targetGene")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    regulatoryGene,
    analysis_scope,
    wgcna_module,
    Fisher_p_value,
    GO.ID,
    targetGene
  )

go_gene_long_csv <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "TF_GO_BP_significant_gene_long.csv"
)
readr::write_csv(
  tf_go_significant_gene_long,
  go_gene_long_csv,
  na = "NA"
)

cat(
  "Gene-level significant TF GO table: ",
  nrow(tf_go_significant_gene_long),
  " rows -> ",
  go_gene_long_csv,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

# Pooled top-module and all-GRN target GO

For each TF in the top-10-per-module union, Biological Process enrichment is
run twice with topGO's `weight01` Fisher test. One query pools that TF's
targets across every module where it ranks in the top 10. The other query is
every target of that TF in the consensus top-3% network. The background is
every unique target gene in that network. Terms with Fisher p < 0.05 are
retained. No further p-value correction is applied.

```{r pooled-and-all-grn-tf-go}
go_root_ids <- c("GO:0008150", "GO:0003674", "GO:0005575")
max_annotated <- 300L
pooled_p_cutoff <- 0.05

all_genes <- consensus_filtered %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(targetGene), trimws(as.character(targetGene)) != "") %>%
  dplyr::pull(targetGene) %>%
  unique()

go_pairs <- readr::read_tsv(
  here::here("MT_genome", "annotation", "GO_gene_pairs_MtrunA17r5.tsv"),
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(gene = trimws(LOCUS_TAG), go = trimws(GO)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", !is.na(go), go != "") %>%
  dplyr::distinct()
GO2genes <- split(go_pairs$gene, go_pairs$go)

parse_target_genes <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(x), ";\\s*", perl = TRUE), use.names = FALSE))
  unique(x[!is.na(x) & x != "" & x != "NA"])
}

acronym_product_col <- function(acr, prod) {
  a <- trimws(as.character(acr))
  p <- trimws(as.character(prod))
  a <- if (length(a) == 0L || is.na(a) || a == "") NA_character_ else a
  p <- if (length(p) == 0L || is.na(p) || p == "") NA_character_ else p
  if (is.na(a) && is.na(p)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  if (is.na(a)) {
    return(p)
  }
  if (is.na(p)) {
    return(a)
  }
  paste(a, p, sep = "; ")
}

empty_long <- function() {
  tibble::tibble(
    regulatoryGene = character(0),
    tf_acronym = character(0),
    tf_product = character(0),
    query_set = character(0),
    query_gene_n = integer(0),
    GO.ID = character(0),
    GO_term_enriched = character(0),
    Annotated = integer(0),
    Significant = integer(0),
    Expected = double(0),
    significant = logical(0),
    fold_enriched = double(0),
    Fisher.pval = double(0)
  )
}

run_pooled_go <- function(query_genes) {
  query_genes <- intersect(unique(query_genes), all_genes)
  n_query <- length(query_genes)
  if (n_query < 5L) {
    return(list(n_query = n_query, terms = empty_long()))
  }

  gene_list <- stats::setNames(as.integer(all_genes %in% query_genes), all_genes)
  GOdata <- methods::new(
    "topGOdata",
    ontology = "BP",
    allGenes = gene_list,
    geneSel = function(x) x == 1,
    annot = annFUN.GO2genes,
    GO2genes = GO2genes,
    nodeSize = 5
  )
  res_fisher <- runTest(GOdata, algorithm = "weight01", statistic = "fisher")
  tested_term_n <- length(score(res_fisher))
  if (tested_term_n == 0L) {
    return(list(n_query = n_query, terms = empty_long()))
  }

  topgo_bp <- GenTable(
    GOdata,
    Fisher = res_fisher,
    orderBy = "Fisher",
    ranksOf = "Fisher",
    topNodes = tested_term_n,
    numChar = 1000
  )
  if (nrow(topgo_bp) == 0L) {
    return(list(n_query = n_query, terms = empty_long()))
  }

  go_info <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    GO.db,
    keys = unique(topgo_bp$GO.ID),
    keytype = "GOID",
    columns = c("TERM", "ONTOLOGY")
  ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(GOID, .keep_all = TRUE)

  terms <- topgo_bp %>%
    dplyr::left_join(go_info %>% dplyr::rename(GO.ID = GOID), by = "GO.ID") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      term_label = dplyr::coalesce(TERM, Term),
      Fisher.pval = dplyr::if_else(grepl("^<", Fisher), 1e-30, as.numeric(Fisher)),
      Expected_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(Expected))),
      Significant_num = suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(Significant)))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !GO.ID %in% go_root_ids,
      Annotated <= max_annotated,
      !is.na(Fisher.pval),
      Fisher.pval < pooled_p_cutoff
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Fisher.pval) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      GO.ID,
      GO_term_enriched = term_label,
      Annotated,
      Significant = Significant_num,
      Expected = Expected_num,
      significant = TRUE,
      fold_enriched = dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(Expected) & Expected > 0 & !is.na(Significant),
        Significant / Expected,
        NA_real_
      ),
      Fisher.pval
    )

  list(n_query = n_query, terms = terms)
}

summarise_terms <- function(terms) {
  if (nrow(terms) == 0L) {
    return(list(
      significant = FALSE,
      fold_enrichment = NA_character_,
      Target_Gene_GoTerm_enriched = NA_character_
    ))
  }
  list(
    significant = TRUE,
    fold_enrichment = paste(
      ifelse(
        is.finite(terms$fold_enriched),
        format(round(as.numeric(terms$fold_enriched), 3), trim = TRUE, nsmall = 0),
        ""
      ),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    Target_Gene_GoTerm_enriched = paste(
      paste0(terms$GO_term_enriched, "; ", terms$GO.ID),
      collapse = "; "
    )
  )
}

pooled_go_results <- purrr::map(seq_len(nrow(tf_summary_across_modules)), function(i) {
  tf_row <- tf_summary_across_modules[i, , drop = FALSE]
  rg <- tf_row$regulatoryGene[[1]]
  sub <- dplyr::filter(top10_each_module, regulatoryGene == rg)
  pooled_targets <- unique(unlist(
    lapply(sub$target_genes_subnetwork, parse_target_genes),
    use.names = FALSE
  ))
  all_targets <- consensus_filtered %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      regulatoryGene == rg,
      !is.na(targetGene),
      trimws(as.character(targetGene)) != ""
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(targetGene) %>%
    unique()

  list(
    tf_row = tf_row,
    all_grn = run_pooled_go(all_targets),
    subnetwork = run_pooled_go(pooled_targets)
  )
})

bind_scope_terms <- function(result, scope) {
  scope_key <- c(
    all_GRN_targets = "all_grn",
    subnetwork_targets_combined = "subnetwork"
  )[[scope]]
  tested <- result[[scope_key]]
  tested$terms %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      regulatoryGene = result$tf_row$regulatoryGene[[1]],
      tf_acronym = result$tf_row$tf_acronym[[1]],
      tf_product = result$tf_row$tf_product[[1]],
      query_set = scope,
      query_gene_n = tested$n_query,
      .before = 1
    )
}

pooled_go_long <- purrr::map_dfr(pooled_go_results, function(result) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    bind_scope_terms(result, "all_GRN_targets"),
    bind_scope_terms(result, "subnetwork_targets_combined")
  )
})
if (nrow(pooled_go_long) == 0L) {
  pooled_go_long <- empty_long()
}

pooled_go_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(pooled_go_results, function(result) {
  tf_row <- result$tf_row
  modules_label <- gsub("; ", " ", as.character(tf_row$modules_top10[[1]]), fixed = TRUE)
  purrr::map_dfr(
    c("all_GRN_targets", "subnetwork_targets_combined"),
    function(scope) {
      tested <- result[[c(
        all_GRN_targets = "all_grn",
        subnetwork_targets_combined = "subnetwork"
      )[[scope]]]]
      term_summary <- summarise_terms(tested$terms)
      tibble::tibble(
        TF_ID = tf_row$regulatoryGene[[1]],
        acronym_TF_product = acronym_product_col(
          tf_row$tf_acronym[[1]],
          tf_row$tf_product[[1]]
        ),
        query_set = scope,
        target_gene_in_modules = modules_label,
        CombinedQueryGene = tested$n_query,
        significant = term_summary$significant,
        fold_enrichment = term_summary$fold_enrichment,
        Target_Gene_GoTerm_enriched = term_summary$Target_Gene_GoTerm_enriched
      )
    }
  )
})

subnetwork_long <- pooled_go_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(query_set == "subnetwork_targets_combined")
all_grn_long <- pooled_go_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(query_set == "all_GRN_targets")

go_csv_long <- file.path(out_dir, "TF_top10_targets_GO_BP_significant_top3GRN_background.csv")
go_csv_all_long <- file.path(out_dir, "TF_all_GRN_targets_GO_BP_significant_top3GRN_background.csv")
go_csv_wide <- file.path(out_dir, "TF_top10_targets_GO_BP_TF_summary_top3GRN_background.csv")
readr::write_csv(subnetwork_long, go_csv_long)
readr::write_csv(all_grn_long, go_csv_all_long)
readr::write_csv(pooled_go_summary, go_csv_wide)

cat(
  "Pooled TF target GO (BP, weight01, p < 0.05):\n",
  "  Subnetwork-combined terms: ", nrow(subnetwork_long), " -> ", go_csv_long, "\n",
  "  All-GRN-target terms: ", nrow(all_grn_long), " -> ", go_csv_all_long, "\n",
  "  Summary rows: ", nrow(pooled_go_summary), " -> ", go_csv_wide, "\n",
  sep = ""
)
```
